newsitem.title: USA: Ariel Corp secures $10 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Ariel Corp secures $10 mln credit facility.

text.p: Ariel Corp said Thursday it has completed a $10 million credit facility with Transamerica Business Credit Corp's Technology Finance Division, of Farmington, Conn. This facility provides a five-year, $6.0 million term loan and a three-year, $4.0 million revolving credit facility.
The company said the term loan provides for an immediate advance of $3.0 million and a second advance of $3.0 million upon if any one of certain milestones set forth in the agreement are acheived.
The revolving credit facility provides for up to $4.0 million in advances based on a formula of eligible accounts receivable and inventory.
